title: Red flag: unhealed residual limb with active infection
referral_text: Patient P-4120, 58-year-old male, 132 kg, 175 cm. Left transtibial amputation 5 weeks ago due to diabetic foot infection. The distal suture line still has a 2 cm area of dehiscence with purulent discharge; patient is on oral antibiotics. Type 2 diabetes poorly controlled (HbA1c 9.4%), chronic kidney disease stage 3, ischaemic heart disease with limited exercise tolerance. Before amputation walked only within the home. Goal: transfer and short indoor walking. Family requests prosthetic fitting as soon as possible.
